notes.title: 1 Week to Release. Thank you everybody.
notes.content:
Dear Fiends,

We're excited to announce that "Vorax" is just one week away from releasing in Early Access on[b] July 18th.[/b]
 To celebrate this milestone, we released a new teaser trailer that encapsulates the essence of the game.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lMSHbFGU1L4

The journey to this point has been one of relentless effort, passion and dedication. Over the past three years, our team has poured blood, sweat, and tears into finding the perfect balance between survival and horror mechanics. We hope we have succeeded, we will submit to your judgment and we will always try to improve during Early Access.
Furthermore, from an artistic point of view we have always followed our vision and are immensely proud of the monster designs, and we sincerely hope that players enjoy all of these elements as much as we do.

[h1]Early Access and Beyond[/h1]
As we embark on this early access journey, we are committed to continually updating and improving "Vorax." Our goal is to add tons of new content over the next year, with the aim of crafting the best survival horror experience out there. Your feedback will be invaluable in shaping the future of the game, and we look forward to evolving and enhancing the world of "Vorax" together with our community.

[b]We would never have made this release without the support of our community and all Indiegala users that loved our website and our games.
Thanks to everyone who supported us and will support us. Thank you on behalf of the entire Indiegala team.[/b]

Stay vigilant and prepare for the horrors that await. Watch the teaser trailer now and get ready to dive into "Vorax" on July 18th.

notes.title: PMCW Intelligence Document No. 010178. Codename: Vorax
notes.content:
PMCW Intelligence Document No. 010178.

Information in our possession is conflicting, but it seems that the infection has spread very quickly within a few days, perhaps even in a few hours.
It seems that in the hours immediately following the outbreak of the infection, 43rd NATO airborne battalion was sent to the island but all contacts were lost after only 8 hours.

PMCW considers this matter with the utmost importance.
Objectives of team W1 are:
[list]
[*] Locate the biolab
[*] Take in vitro samples of the pathogen (codename: "Vorax")
[*] Liquidate surviving medical personnel (optionally) and any witnesses.
[/list]
[b]In NO case must the presence of the PMCW be revealed.[/b]
 
Every W1 squad member is equipped with cyanide capsules. 
Squad commander is authorized to start liquidation procedure in case of emergency.

Proceed with the utmost caution.

[previewyoutube=-xl04-CDLv0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]THE ENVIRONMENT[/b]

The island is vast and offers a wide variety of natural resources. There are also several settlements, a main village, a hotel and tourist attractions.
In the event of an emergency landing, or loss of tactical equipment, each squad member is trained to survive in a hostile environment.
As a good mercenary of a private military company, you know how to use local plants and herbs to make ointments and medications to treat state effects such as burns, bleeding, relieve your stress or simply restore your health.
But more importantly, you can use building materials provided by nature to make rudimentary melee weapons, traps, barricades and much more.  Even a silent bow, very useful for knocking out the infected without being detected.

[b]THE INFECTION[/b]

It seems that the infected are the side effect of the virus grown in the bio-laboratory.
Probably when a security flaw opened, the virus spread to the island.

It is not yet clear whether it spreads by air or through aquifers but what is certain is that biomass, similar to fleshy appendages that are sometimes glimpsed in the environment, are one of the final stages of the virus.
The biomass therefore seems to be responsible for the mutations that occurred to the civilian inhabitants and to the military personnel who rushed to contain the first stages of the infection.
[b]Contact with non-bottled liquids or non-canned food is therefore  strictly prohibited.[/b]

Mutates are fast, extremely aggressive and above all voracious.
The first to be devoured were the breeding animals of the surrounding farms and estates.
For this reason, any living being, human or animal, is for them a [b]prey[/b].

Apparently they do not devour each other ( to be confirmed ).

Finally, it seems that they are photosensitive. 
At least the infected humans.
Our drones have in fact observed the absence of external diurnal activity by the mutants, even if some animal species that have come into contact with the pathogen, such as stray dogs, wolves, wild boars and bears, do not seem to suffer from photosensitivity.

[b]It is therefore recommended to exercise extreme caution at night.[/b]


[b]OPERATIONAL INFO[/b]

You will land in the North area, a few hundred meters from the bio-laboratory, at 4.30 in the morning.
The helicopter will wait 25 minutes and then will take off.

notes.title: Update v1.5.0 - Full release incoming!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29067535/33618dd4e36960ed1127ede1f17832e33c789875.png[/img]

Bring in some friends and unlock the true potential of [b]Stayin' Alive[/b]! In this version:
[list]
	[*][b]Play up to 8 vs 8![/b]
	[*]Four new Suicider characters!
	[*]Hospital map is now fully open!
	[*]Room host can change map and match time directly from Room menu
	[*]Players will always return to Room menu after a match
	[*]Automatic match start is now delayed by some seconds, when a room is full
	[*]Nicer room information box in the Room menu
	[*]Improved AIs behavior (searching items, navigating, etc)
	[*]Savior AIs will drop their passive power-ups after a while, instead of keeping them forever
	[*]Improved item spawning criteria
	[*]Fixed a couple of major bugs when using the Blowgun
	[*]More bug fixing and improvements here and there
[/list]
Time to go all in! You can now choose to play with up to 8 players per team, included AIs like before.
Hospital map will now open up to all four floors, depending by the number of players in a room (when playing 8 vs 8, maps will always be fully open).

Next, we decided to drop the concept of [i]"Single round"[/i], [i]"Multiple rounds"[/i] and [i]"Map rotation"[/i] for a clearer experience. From now on the host will be able to change map and time in the Room menu, and after every match all players will be sent back to the Room screen.

[h1]Full release coming soon![/h1]
[b]We are going out of Early Access in a few weeks![/b] We will have just a couple more updates before that day. After that, we will continue supporting the game with fixes and some more extra content. :)

This is all for today's update. Thanks for playing and stay tuned! ;)

notes.title: Update v1.0.0
notes.content:
Say hello to version [b]ONE[/b] of Stayin' Alive! Here's the changelog:
[list]
	[*]Fixed getting stuck in crafting animation
	[*]Fixed disabled audio when playing as Client
	[*]Fixed missing music when joining a started match
	[*]Improved logic when joining a match
	[*]Fixed various syncing bugs
	[*]More smaller bugs fixed
[/list]
We managed to fix many sync problems by changing the logic of how a player joins a match. Now, when joining a started match, the player will replace any bot that is [b]not[/b] in a special condition (like dying, crafting, sedated, ecc). If all the bots are "busy" in that moment, the game will just wait for the first one to free up.
This is an elegant solution that makes things way easier to sync, and it's nicer for players.

EDIT: now that v1.0.0 is out, more players are playing and more bugs are spawning. :D
Of course we already found some! In the next days we will do everything to fix what's possible before the Christmas and New Year's Eve holidays.

See you next update!

[list]

notes.title: Speak German? + Dev update
notes.content:
Hello players! 

[h1]Beta channel build with German translation[/h1]
Gamescom has started and IndieGala is now there with Stayin' Alive among the other games. The event is taking place in Germany, so we thought it could make sense to have German language in the game!

Please note that this new build is marked as 0.6.2 thus wont' play against current 0.6.1 version; maybe grab a friend and try the new german build together! [h1]Development update[/h1]
Some days ago we revealed the new Hospital map and we hope you liked it. We really wanted to add it to this new build in the Beta channel but unfortunately, due to problems with the old codebase, we really couldn't make it in time and chosen to continue making progress instead.
We are sorry to keep you waiting but we are getting there, there's not much left! We promise you a smoother experience and way more content updates when all this work is done. Just hang on a bit more! ç_ç

Thanks for sticking with us! Happy gaming!
